tagline: CLI tool for generating production-ready Discord bot projects with automated setup.

details.overview: Build Discord App is a Node.js CLI tool that helps developers quickly scaffold Discord bot projects using predefined templates. It automates project setup, configuration, and folder structure generation, reducing repetitive setup work and improving development workflow.
engineering_challenges: Designing an intuitive CLI workflow for developers
Handling project generation and file system operations safely
Managing template downloads and project configuration
Supporting existing directories without breaking user files
key_features: Template-based project generation using remote repositories
Safe handling of existing project directories
what_i_learned: Working with file systems and project scaffolding
